messages:
Pax: hey all — Pax here, joined last week on infra-eng. Trying to repro a regression that only appears when a prod feature flag is flipped. I have staging admin access but not the prod toggle permission. I opened RED-1234 with logs. Who can approve a short temp toggle or point to the exact runbook? @Ana @Devon
Ana: welcome Pax! :wave: for prod toggles we usually need a quick justification + time window. can you paste the flag name and repro steps here? cc: security if needed
Pax: thanks Ana. flag name is `ui.experimental_kv_cache`
Repro steps: 1) login as user id 78612 2) navigate to /benchmarks -> click run -> observe 503s for requests > 10k tokens 3) flip flag, repro disappears
I really only need to flip it for ~20 minutes to confirm rollback works and capture logs.
Devon: thanks — please file an access request form (https://intranet.redwood/access-requests) and include RED-1234 + the time window. we'll need a manager or product owner to ack. can you paste the prod user id and the exact timestamp window you'll need?
Pax: filing now, requesting 20m window: 2026-03-23T15:00Z -> 2026-03-23T15:20Z. prod user id 78612. added repro steps to RED-1234.
Irene: quick note — if this is just to validate a rollback, we can grant a scoped `prod-flag-editor` role for 30m after a 1-click approval in req-prod-access. I'll ping ops-oncall. also: leave a breadcrumb in the Console audit (we'll need the trace id).
Devon: pinged ops-oncall, also @Ana can you ack the product impact to speed this up?
Ana: acked — product impact: high (blocks critical ingest path for a small % of users). approving temporary toggle for 30m if ops approves.
access-bot: [access-request-created] AR-789: requester=Pax, scope=prod-flag-editor, window=2026-03-23T15:00Z/2026-03-23T15:30Z, ticket=RED-1234
Devon: ops-oncall approved in channel, granting staging -> already done. provisioning prod-scoped role now, will post when live.
access-bot: [role-granted] user=Pax, role=prod-flag-editor, expires=2026-03-23T15:30:00Z, audit_link=https://console.redwood/audit/AR-789
Pax: got it — I can see the toggle in the admin panel now. I'll flip at 15:05 UTC and report back immediately with logs+trace id. thanks everyone. :pray:
Irene: remember to include the trace id and revert if anything unexpected.
Pax: flipped at 15:05Z — traffic stabilized. trace_id=trc-20260323-7b9e. reverting back now and attaching logs to RED-1234.
access-bot: [role-revoked] user=Pax, role=prod-flag-editor, revoked=2026-03-23T15:30:02Z
Ana: great work Pax, and welcome aboard — short and clean. if you want a walkthrough of the Console audit tooling, ping me or put on your onboarding checklist.
Pax: appreciate it!
